name: @somework/jira-triage
description: The Jira triage role: checks every new ticket against a fixed checklist for its issue type, asks the reporter (on Slack, else in Jira) for what is missing, optionally has the developer agent investigate read-only first, and creates tickets from Slack conversations (jira.triage). A card, a profile, a seeded event handler and a durable triage queue on top of @somework/agent-kit.
